# ENTITY v3.4.3

ENTITY is an Apache-2.0 open-source protocol and reference implementation from Blackmore Technology Group Limited for sovereign digital authority, delegated rights, provenance/evidence, portable recovery, interoperable economic state, and the Blackmore Technology Data Universe (BTDU).

Current supported ENTITY runtime: v3.4.3
BTDU component in v3.4.3: 3.4.2 unchanged
Source: https://github.com/blackmore-technology-group/ENTITY
Current release: https://github.com/blackmore-technology-group/ENTITY/releases/tag/v3.4.3
Documentation: https://blackmore-technology-group.github.io/ENTITY-DOCS/
Technical discovery hub: https://blackmore-technology-group.github.io/ENTITY-DOCS/discover/
Updates feed: https://blackmore-technology-group.github.io/ENTITY-DOCS/feed.xml
Research and citation: https://blackmore-technology-group.github.io/ENTITY-DOCS/research/
Standards and interoperability: https://blackmore-technology-group.github.io/ENTITY-DOCS/standards/
Standards review issue: https://github.com/blackmore-technology-group/ENTITY/issues/69
External verification challenge: https://github.com/blackmore-technology-group/ENTITY/issues/55
External Repository Qualification campaign: https://github.com/blackmore-technology-group/ENTITY/issues/78

## Version boundary

v3.4.2 remains immutable historical evidence and is superseded for current deployment. Some clean-room, audit and qualification tasks intentionally retain v3.4.2 because that is the exact frozen artifact they reproduce or review. Do not reinterpret those historical version labels as current-release status.

Historical v3.4.2 + BTDU documentation: https://blackmore-technology-group.github.io/ENTITY-DOCS/v342/

## Core primitives

ENTITY → AUTHORITY → RIGHT → EVENT → VALUE

## Architecture boundaries

- ENTITY governs authority, rights, provenance, economic state and recovery.
- ADAM is the deterministic atom/bond state engine.
- BTDU provides governed information topology, reusable atoms/bonds/compounds, indexes and repository manifests.
- BTDU component version remains 3.4.2 in ENTITY v3.4.3.
- NIKI provides bounded reasoning/projection and is not the authority root.
- Infrastructure possession does not automatically create sovereign authority.
- Provenance does not automatically establish objective truth or legal ownership.
- Protocol origin does not transfer downstream user asset ownership to Blackmore Technology Group.
- Repository ingestion, mirroring, registration, verification or custody do not create upstream ownership or automatic economic entitlement.
- Canonical protocol origin creates no automatic protocol royalty; economic participation requires explicit terms.

## External evidence

An unrelated GitHub contributor reproduced the published Java v3.4.2 26-vector baseline on Windows 11 with 26/26 PASS, the exact sealed-kit hash, the exact canonical result hash and overall_valid=true. This is meaningful external reproduction of a BTG-controlled baseline, not a fully independently authored ENTITY implementation.

## Evidence boundary

BTG-controlled testing is not presented as unrelated third-party validation. External reproduction of a BTG baseline is not automatically an independently authored protocol implementation. Exact released code, signed records, manifests, schemas, hashes and qualification evidence remain controlling for their respective claims.
